title: Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes
abstract: arXiv:2610.40318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the accuracy and calibration of Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes. Methods: Two benchmarks were analysed: 172 rheumatology questions from Spanish specialty-training examinations (expanded RheumaMIR dataset) in Spanish and English, and 70 English diagnostic vignettes from RheumBench with 5-18 candidate diagnoses, 52 of which included the reference diagnosis. Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya) and GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API) were compared with GPT-6 Sol and two local generative models. translated_title: 风湿病学中的决策模型与系统一模型：在专科培训考试题目和诊断病例摘要上的准确度与校准度
translated_abstract: 目的：评估决策模型与系统一模型在风湿病学考试题目和诊断病例摘要上的准确度与校准度。方法：分析了两个基准测试：来自西班牙专科培训考试的172道风湿病学题目（扩展版RheumaMIR数据集，包含西班牙语和英语版本），以及来自RheumBench的70个英语诊断病例摘要（每个包含5-18个候选诊断，其中52个包含参考诊断）。将四个系统一模型（Jev 1.13、Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1、Laya）和GPT-6 Luna（OpenAI Decisions API）与GPT-6 Sol及两个本地生成式模型进行比较。主要结局指标为准确度；次要结局指标包括校准度、区分度、概率≥0.90的答案的准确度以及语言差异。结果：在RheumaMIR基准中，Jev的准确度在西班牙语中为93.0%，在英语中为91.9%，低于GPT-6 Sol（99.4%；经Holm校正P≤0.005）；GPT-6 Luna达到97.7%，Clef为91.9-93.0%……
tldr: 该研究系统评估了新型“决策/系统一”AI模型在风湿病学专科考试题目和诊断病例摘要上的准确度与校准度，发现这些模型表现良好但整体准确度仍不及GPT-6 Sol等生成式大模型，且存在语言和校准方面的差异。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates the accuracy and calibration of new Decision/System One AI models on rheumatology specialty-training exam questions and diagnostic vignettes, finding that although these models perform well, their overall accuracy generally remains below that of the generative model GPT-6 Sol, with differences across languages and calibration.
